about: state-lower contests of 1979 in Louisiana, in the layout of plan/PLAN.md section 3 with the fields data/README.md adds (D3). Built by pipeline/local.py from pipeline/intake/klarner_state_legislative.py's cache.

klarner.name: Carl Klarner, State Legislative Election Returns, 1967-2022, Harvard Dataverse doi:10.7910/DVN/FJOGJB, v1.0, released 2024-06-12T21:56:14Z
klarner.note: compiled by Klarner from official state returns (state election offices' websites when collected, and the earlier ICPSR editions); the origin of each race is not named, and whether a count is before or after a recount is not stated per race

nara.name: National Archives, Electoral College Results (the sitting president's party)
nara.licence: US federal public record; no licence printed

model.name: the model's own forecast, method D3-v1.1
model.note: each year forecast from a fit on earlier years only; no polls are used
